_comment: Civic incident categories. Add an entry to support a new category; no code change needed.

categories.label: Pothole / Road Damage
categories.title_placeholder: Large pothole near the main crossing
categories.description_placeholder: A deep pothole on the left side of the road. Vehicles swerve to avoid it.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Repair or make the damaged section safe.
Take a photo of the finished work from the same spot.

categories.label: Garbage / Cleanliness
categories.description_placeholder: Waste is piling up around the bin and spilling onto the road.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clear the waste.
Take a photo of the cleaned area.

categories.label: Water Leakage
categories.title_placeholder: Water leaking from a pipeline at the corner
categories.description_placeholder: Clean water has been leaking onto the road since morning.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Stop or repair the leak, or note that it needs a specialist.
Take a photo showing the result.

categories.label: Drainage / Waterlogging
categories.description_placeholder: The roadside drain is blocked and water collects across the lane.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Clear the blockage.
Take a photo showing water flowing.

categories.label: Broken Streetlight
categories.description_placeholder: The streetlight has been off for a week and the lane is dark at night.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map and find the pole.
Repair or replace the light.
Take a photo showing the pole and the light.

categories.label: Damaged Public Infrastructure
categories.description_placeholder: The seat plank of the second bench from the gate is broken.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Repair or secure the asset.
Take a photo of the finished work.

categories.label: Public Safety Hazard
categories.description_placeholder: A large branch has fallen across the footpath; people are walking on the road.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Make the hazard safe or remove it.
Take a photo showing the cleared area.

categories.label: Other Civic Issue
categories.description_placeholder: Describe the issue in your own words.
instructions: Go to the pin on the map.
Resolve the issue.
Take a photo of the result.
